content.text: Joe called and said she'd be here in a sec.
content.trans: 英语：乔打电话说她会很快到。

content.text: She said she got tied up with a client.
content.trans: 她说她被一个客户绑定了。

content.text: Sorry I'm late everyone.
content.trans: 英语：对不起，大家。

content.text: Oh there was a huge traffic jam on the highway this morning.
content.trans: 英语：今天早上高速公路发生了一场大拥堵。

content.text: Morning everyone.
content.trans: 早上大家好。

content.text: Are you stuck in traffic as well Jess?
content.trans: 英语：你也在等红绿灯吗？

content.text: There was a huge pile up on the highway and traffic was backed up for miles.
content.trans: 这里有一条高速公路被堵得水泄不通，交通堵塞了整整几英里。

content.text: Jess called and said that he's running late.
content.trans: 英语：杰西打电话并说他有点晚点。

content.text: His last meeting ran over but he's on his way now.
content.trans: 他的最后一次会议已经结束，但他现在正赶路。

content.text: Guys this is not acceptable.
content.trans: 英语：这不算是合格的。

content.text: If I say the meeting starts at 10 then meeting starts at 10.
content.trans: 如果我说会议开始的时间是10点，那么会议也从10点开始。

content.text: Not 10.
And definitely not 10.
content.trans: 而且绝对不是十。

content.text: All right let's get started.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: So the first thing I want to talk about is our.
content.trans: 所以，我首先想谈谈我们的。

content.text: I'm really sorry everyone I know I'm late but really it's not my fault I was getting coffee
content.trans: 英语：我真的很抱歉，我知道我在等你，但说实话，这并不是我的错。我正在喝咖啡。

content.text: at Starbucks and the line was way way too long.
content.trans: 英语：在星巴克和排队的人多得数不清。

content.text: I was waiting for 20 minutes to get my coffee.
content.trans: 我等了两个小时来喝咖啡。

content.text: Well Marco I know that ideas about time and ideas about being late are different in
content.trans: 英语：嗯，Marco，我知道关于时间的概念和关于迟到的观念是不同的。

content.text: different countries.
content.trans: 不同的国家。

content.text: Yeah in different countries people treat time or being on time in different ways.
content.trans: 是的，在不同的国家，人们对待时间或准时有不同的方式。

content.text: Yeah like I'm from Canada and I look at being on time really different than you do right?
content.trans: 嗯，我从加拿大过来，感觉和你对待时间的方式完全不同。

content.text: Yes because for example if you call for a meeting at 9 o'clock.
content.trans: 是的，因为例如如果您在9点召开会议。

content.text: Yep.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Actually people will be there at 9 o'clock because the meeting will start in America.
content.trans: 实际上，人们将在九点左右在那里集合，因为会议将在美国开始。

content.text: Right in America.
content.trans: 美国在哪儿？

content.text: Now for example Latin America we do have this what we call sometimes the Latino time or
content.trans: 现在让我们用这个拉丁美洲的时间来举例，我们有时称之为“拉丁时间”或“拉丁时区”。

content.text: Hispanic time which is like 9 o'clock is like the time that everyone should be there but
content.trans: 英语：拉丁美洲时间，也就是像9点这样的人应该去的地方。

content.text: until people get there get their coffee and whatever then it'll be 9.15 maybe up to 9.30.
content.trans: 直到人们到达那里，他们就可以喝咖啡和什么了。然后可能会上升到9.30。

content.text: And I think it's a little bit even more noticeable when we're talking about social events.
content.trans: 而且我认为，当我们谈论社交活动时，它在某种程度上确实更加明显。

content.text: Like if you go to someone's house for dinner in Canada they say come to my house at 6 o'clock
content.trans: 英语：如果你们去加拿大某人的家吃饭，他们会说来我家6点。

content.text: for dinner you'll be there at 6.05 right?
content.trans: 对于晚餐，您将在6点5分到达吗？

content.text: Okay yeah usually you'll be there only a couple of minutes after the time that was specified
content.trans: 英语：好的，通常你将在时间指定后几分钟内到达。

content.text: just to give the house owner a little bit of time.
content.trans: 英语：只需给房主一些时间。

content.text: But if we have a dinner invitation for 6 we know that it's not really going to begin
content.trans: 但是如果我们有六道菜的邀请函，我们并不知道这会真的开始。

content.text: eating at 6.00 so people will get there at 6.30 or 7.00 and of course food isn't ready
content.trans: 吃午饭，所以人们会在12点或13点或者14点到达那里，并且食物还没准备好。

content.text: until like maybe 8.00 or 9.
content.trans: 直到像可能是8.00或9。

content.text: But in German countries from what I know you've got to be if they say be there at 6.00 right?
content.trans: 但是，在我所知的范围内，你必须在6点准时到达。

content.text: And also I think it's about when people start work right?
content.trans: 而且我认为，人们开始工作的时间也是关于什么？

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: How on time you have to begin work sometimes it's acceptable to be 10 or 15 minutes so
content.trans: 英语：有时你得早点开始工作，10到15分钟就足够了。

content.text: called late but in other places you know.
content.trans: 英语：被叫晚了，但在其他地方你知道。

content.text: Yeah in North America if you're supposed to start work at 9 you have to be at your desk
content.trans: 是的，在美国，如果你在9点开始工作，你必须在你的办公室。

content.text: working at 9.
content.trans: 工作到9点。

content.text: At 9.
Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: And in other countries people get there at 9.
content.trans: 在其他国家，人们通常会提前到达。

content.text: Get their coffee maybe take a quick glance at their emails or the newspaper and then
content.trans: 英语：请他们喝咖啡，或许先给他们看一下他们的电子邮件或报纸，然后。

content.text: you know start working at around 9.30 or 10.
content.trans: 你大概需要在9点半或10点开始工作。

content.text: So I guess the important thing is to know what the tradition is in the country where you
content.trans: 英语：所以我认为最重要的事情是如何了解你所在国家的传统。

content.text: are.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Exactly so come to our website englishpod.com and let us know how it works in your countries
content.trans: 请放心，我会用中文为您翻译。以下是您提供的英文：

content.text: I know that many different countries have a different way of treating time so share it
content.trans: 英语：我知道许多不同的国家有不同的对待时间的方式，所以分享一下。

content.text: with us.
content.trans: 与我们。

content.text: Yes and remember if you have any questions please ask them at the website as well.
content.trans: 是的，而且，请在网站上随时提问。

content.text: We're out of time today but until next time thanks for listening and goodbye.
content.trans: 今天时间不多了，下次再聊。谢谢你的倾听，再见！

content.text: Bye bye.
content.trans: 再见。
